entry.title: Commission proposes a new Standardisation Regulation
entry.summary: COM(2026) 780 would replace Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012: deadlines for every standardisation request, interim deliverables with a presumption of conformity, designated standards bodies besides CEN, CENELEC and ETSI when they are late, and free online access to every cited standard. Nothing changes for the standards manufacturers use today: M/606 for the CRA expires in November 2027 and runs under the current rules. The proposal matters for the second phase of machinery standards (M/605, due 2034), which would run across the switch without a transitional rule, and for interim deliverables, which the CRA and the Machinery Regulation do not yet recognise for the presumption of conformity.

entry.title: Digital Omnibus: Council mandate for talks with Parliament revised (not public)
entry.summary: The register lists a revision (REV 1) of 5 October of the draft mandate of 2 October; neither is public yet. Coreper has to agree a mandate before trilogues can start. Until Coreper agrees the mandate and the Council publishes it, the Council's position on the Digital Omnibus is not officially known. Trilogues can start only after that.

entry.title: European Product Act proposal postponed to later in 2026
entry.summary: Planned for 6 October 2026 together with the Standardisation Regulation; the Commission now expects to present it later this year, with the changes to sector legislation. Date to be confirmed. For products nothing changes now: Decision 768/2008/EC, Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 and Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 stay in force. The Standardisation Regulation goes ahead on its own for the time being.
